A late-evening deployment from the bridge of a working container ship on a cold calm Nordic sea. The captain in three-quarter profile close to a lovingly restored brass ship's telegraph, broad flipper waiting above a single green departure toggle. Through wide bridge windows, a long deck stacked with securely lashed containers vanishes toward a dark blue channel, with green navigation light and storm clouds clearing in the distance. Three tiny green lights on his old panel line up after successful checks. Details: stencilless ridged container doors, brass bridge fittings, rain beads on glass, amber task light, his battered leather logbook lying next to a chipped coffee mug. Maintain his warm quiet expression and familiar navy sweater/mustard cap, no pipe, no maritime costume changes. Broad cinematic framing with the captain large and centered toward left, distinct technical action and good depth. Midnight blue, ochre and warm lantern light.
